attributes.otel.scope.name: a2ui-spectra-instrumentation
attributes.a2ui.parse.input:
<a2ui>
  <body id="main">
    <script type="application/json">
      {
        "restaurant": {
          "name": "Xi'an Famous Foods",
          "address": "45 Bayard St, New York, NY 10013",
          "rating": "4.6 / 5"
        }
      }
    </script>
    <ui-card id="root">
      <ui-column id="card_body" align="stretch">
        <ui-text id="restaurant_name" text="{$/restaurant/name}" />
        <ui-row id="rating_row" align="center">
          <ui-icon id="star_icon" name="star" />
          <ui-text id="rating_value" text="{$/restaurant/rating}" />
        </ui-row>
        <ui-row id="address_row" align="center">
          <ui-icon id="location_icon" name="locationOn" />
          <ui-text id="address_value" text="{$/restaurant/address}" />
        </ui-row>
        <ui-divider id="divider" />
        <ui-button id="book_table_button" variant="primary" on-click="{Event('book_table')}">
          <ui-text id="button_text" text="Book a Table" />
        </ui-button>
      </ui-column>
    </ui-card>
  </body>
</a2ui>
